meta.targetUser: A Magic: The Gathering collector sorting and pricing a physical collection, phone in one hand, cards on the table
meta.coreAction: Scan cards into the right box
meta.source: Code mirror: app/src/main/java/com/mtgscanner/ui/theme/Theme.kt (Palette, Space, Corners, typography). Change both together.
meta.philosophy: unslop (design/unslop, CC BY 4.0, Damir Sokolovsky) is the default; design/Design.md lists where Grimoire departs from it

dark.primaryText: computed: primary lightened to 4.6:1 on bg
dark.onPrimary: computed: white when it reaches 4.5:1 on primary, else near-black

light.primaryText: computed: primary darkened to 4.6:1 on bg
light.onPrimary: computed: white when it reaches 4.5:1 on primary, else near-black

alwaysDark._why: The camera, card art and the game table stay dark in light mode too: art and a shared table read best dark.

domain._why: Colors that mean something in Magic and are not themed: mana symbols (ManaFont), rarity (RarityMark, SetSymbolFont), foil shimmer, player colors, dice and coins, label tape. They live next to the component that draws them.

color._why: Ink-brown darks and paper lights read as an old binder, not a tech dashboard. One accent (oxblood) is kept for actions and the selected state only. Each panel step is clearly lighter than the one below it, because Rae asked for clear contrast between panels and background.

typography.fontNumbers: Lexend tabular lining figures; IBM Plex Mono for the Collection numbers strip
typography._why: Fraunces, a soft old-style serif in upper and lower case, reads like the title page of an old book; Lexend is wide and very legible at small sizes on a phone held at arm's length. Numbers use tabular figures so prices line up in lists. Body line height is 1.4, not the 1.6 used on web pages, because most text here is one-line list rows, not paragraphs.

spacing._why: 8pt grid. 4 and 12 are half steps, used only inside a component (icon to label, chip padding). Screens use a 16dp side margin everywhere.

radius._why: Near-square corners. Rae asked for no big rounded cards.

shadow._why: Panels are separated by a surface step, not shadows.

motion._why: One ease-out curve for everything (unslop). Short for feedback, longer for things that enter. No bounce outside the dice.
